liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (4 reviews): Estimated Prophet into Terrapin and Drums/Space set the reviewer on a new course as a fan; Terrapin sounds great despite Jerry forgetting the storyteller line, dropping it, then trying again [15][19][21][25]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer, at their first show, found the Scarlet into Fire section hot; Scarlet into Fire burns, per the reviewer [15][19]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Estimated Prophet inspired the crowd; the second set also has an up-tempo Fire; Reviewer lists Bird Song, Candyman, Estimated and everything after Space as high points [23][25]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer thinks Jack Straw needed some work but was acceptable overall [14]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Bird Song and Candyman as nice, with Jerry playing well [21]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer calls Candyman a slow drip, with Jerry's vocals and guitar work standing out [23]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea has melting vocals and guitar from Jerry, apart from one sound hiccup a few minutes in [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-05-02.134759.aud.wise.minches.flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 157 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd81-05-02.dmow.28304.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 161 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [4]
- **gd81-05-02.sbd.miller.30152.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard a decent recording [21]
- **gd1981-05-02.174714.sbd.healy.bradt.miller.phase.repair.flac1648**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [8]
- **gd1981-05-02.174687.sbd.healy.bradt.miller.phase.repair.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [9]
- **gd1981-05-02.174671.sbd.healy.bradt.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended their first Dead show here and went on to see nearly every Philadelphia show until 1995 [15]
- After El Paso, Bobby asked for a silent prayer for the 76ers before their upcoming game, saying they needed divine intervention [20]
- Reviewer says the 3/5/81 Scarlet>Fire is far better than this one [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-05-02.134759.aud.wise.minches.flac24**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by David Minches; source: Cassette Audience Master recorded By Jim Wise; Sennheiser MD421 Dynamic Cardioid Microphones-TC D5 Cassette Recorder; Location: Soundboard; Analog to Digital:… [1]
- **gd81-05-02.dmow.28304.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Doug Mow; transferred by Alex Ford; source: Audience Recording: 2 Nak 300 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS tape. (Jeff Silberman's guns on Howard Shame's bodies); [4]. Also: Reviewer did the final transfer of this audience source, calling it a clear upgrade over the other available source [17]
- **gd81-05-02.sbd.miller.30152.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Joe Samaritano & Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1981-05-02.174714.sbd.healy.bradt.miller.phase.repair.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 17, 2025; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Cassette (dbx) [8]. Also: Tapes supplied by Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt; converted from 24bit/96kHz to 16bit/48kHz, with vocals isolated and phase repaired [8]
- **gd1981-05-02.174687.sbd.healy.bradt.miller.phase.repair.flac2496**: taped by Tapes supplied by Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 17, 2025; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Cassette (dbx) [9]. Also: Tapes came from Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt; vocals were isolated and a phase issue repaired, with patch source from Doug Mow and Alex Ford [9]
- **gd1981-05-02.174671.sbd.healy.bradt.miller.flac1648**: taped by Tapes supplied by Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 13, 2025; source: SBD > Cassette Master > Cassette (dbx) [10]
